channel.title: News (English) - World Health Organization
channel.description: Fixture in the shape of the WHO news feed (checked 2026-10-23). The text is made up for tests.

item.title: WHO warns of rising dengue cases among young people
item.description: Dengue cases have risen in 12 countries this season, WHO said. Young people and students should remove standing water around hostels and campuses. Most cases are mild and do not need hospital care.

item.title: New guidance on student mental health and sleep
item.description: WHO published guidance for universities on mental health and sleep. It asks campuses to offer counselling.

item.title: A patient in a campus clinic recovers from dengue
item.description: The patient, a student, recovered after treatment.

item.title: Heat advisory for students
item.description: Drink water during exams in the heat.

item.title: Students and vaccines: a story elsewhere
item.description: A link off the publisher's own site.

item.title: WHO warns of rising dengue cases among young people (again)
Remarks at the budget committee
item.description: The Director-General spoke to the committee on the programme budget.

item.title: Air quality and outdoor sport
item.description: Poor air quality affects outdoor sport. Universities can move practice indoors on bad days.

item.title: Handwashing and hygiene in student hostels
item.description: Hygiene in hostels cuts the spread of infections among students.
